expectations.evidence: The output files are not nested under a features/notification/ directory. Instead, they are placed directly at the root of the outputs directory: api/index.ts, components/NotificationCard/..., components/NotificationList/..., constants/index.ts, hooks/useNotifications.ts, stores/notificationStore.ts, types/index.ts. The required parent path 'features/notification/' is absent.
components/NotificationCard/ contains NotificationCard.tsx and index.ts. components/NotificationList/ contains NotificationList.tsx and index.ts. Both components are organized as dedicated folders.

expectations.text: 每个文件夹有 index.ts 聚合导出
expectations.evidence: While types/, api/, constants/, components/NotificationCard/, and components/NotificationList/ each have index.ts barrel files, the hooks/ directory is missing an index.ts (it only contains useNotifications.ts), and the stores/ directory is missing an index.ts (it only contains notificationStore.ts). Not every folder has an index.ts aggregation export.

expectations.text: store 使用 Zustand（create 或 defineStore 语法）
expectations.evidence: stores/notificationStore.ts imports { create } from 'zustand' at line 1 and defines the store using create<NotificationState>((set, get) => ({...})) at line 80.

expectations.text: 使用 TypeScript + React（函数组件 + Hooks）
expectations.evidence: All files use .ts/.tsx extensions with full TypeScript type annotations including enums, interfaces, and generic types. Components are defined as React.FC function components: NotificationCard.tsx uses 'export const NotificationCard: React.FC<NotificationCardProps>' and NotificationList.tsx uses 'export const NotificationList: React.FC<NotificationListProps>'. Custom hooks are defined in hooks/useNotifications.ts (useNotifications, useNotificationActions, useUnreadCount) using useEffect, useCallback, and Zustand's useNotificationStore.
